scientific_integrity: All mathematical assertions follow from a self-contained combinatorial face classification, a relative integral cellular argument, and combinatorial Alexander duality. A standalone finite consistency checker is provided; no independent certification or external validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Homotopy classification is for the combinatorial Alexander dual only; the original cut complex has only its integral homology computed. The proven mixed-alphabet, at-least-three-factor domain excludes previously studied all-binary and two-factor boundary cases. Unindexed equivalent work may exist. Finite numerical checks do not establish the infinite statement.
title: Mixed-alphabet Hamming graphs: complete integral three-cut homology
